A wall down the middle meant chopping our ancient oak tree perfectly in half. I kicked my back door open, the glass rattling fiercely in its frame. Greg was lounging in a lawn chair, scrolling on his phone. I marched across the grass, my vision tunneling until all I could see was his relaxed posture. I threw the crumpled paper, hitting him squarely in the chest. "You really think," I said, my voice shaking so badly I had to pause, "that you're cutting down that tree?" I kicked the leg of his chair, sending him scrambling to his feet.
topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
